name: gizza-ai/text-to-pdf
summary: Generate a paginated PDF from plain text.

tool.description: Generate a clean, paginated PDF (US Letter) from plain text. Long lines wrap to the text width and the content flows across as many pages as needed, using the built-in Courier monospace font. font_size (points, default 11) and margin (points, default 72 = 1 inch) are configurable. Returns a PDF. Runs locally — the text never leaves the device.

text.description: The plain text to render into a PDF.

font_size.description: Font size in points (default 11). Uses the built-in Courier monospace font.

margin.description: Page margin in points (default 72 = 1 inch). 72 points = 1 inch.
